recorded_from: Sonarr 4.0.20.3014, polling after the same torrent finished downloading
note: state is stalledUP, qBittorrent's own spelling of finished and not currently uploading, not pausedUP: this transfer reached State::Seeding rather than State::Paused. Sonarr's own queue read this torrent as fully fetched (sizeleft 0) but then refused to import it: this torrent has no top level folder inside it, so content_path is identical to save_path, and Sonarr's importer will not pull files out of a directory it cannot tell apart from the category's shared base folder. See harness/README.md; this is a real gap in Braid's content_path, not something the fixture papers over.
